title: Infinite Problem Generator: Verifiably Scaling Physics Reasoning Data with Agentic Workflows
authors_zh: Aditya Sharan, Sriram Hebbale, Dhruv Kumar
paper_type_zh: 可执行物理数据生成器与数据集
best_for_zh: 适合构造可程序检查的物理训练题或评测集的研究者。
one_line: Infinite Problem Generator expands textbook physics seeds into 1,335 problem-code records whose predefined formulas and executed numeric solutions make generation verifiable.
Infinite Problem Generator 将教材物理题扩展为 1,335 条题目与代码记录，并用预定义公式和实际执行的数值解验证生成结果。
why: It provides an operational recipe and record schema for generating physics data with stronger checks than answer-only teacher generation.
inclusion_reason: Releases physics problem records whose formula structure and executable solution make answer verification and failure auditing explicit.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Physics reasoning data are scarce because ordinary text generation can produce fluent but unsolvable questions, inconsistent numbers, or hallucinated formulas. Static benchmarks also rarely expose executable solution traces suitable for training or automatic verification.

Infinite Problem Generator represents physics formulas as Python functions, expands expert textbook seeds into new scenarios, and executes every generated solution before acceptance. Its direct output is ClassicalMechanicsV1, a corpus of problem-code-answer records whose solvability and structural complexity can be checked mechanically.

L4 facts: official source arXiv:2603.14486v1, dated 15 March 2026; arXiv preprint with no confirmed venue; decision boundary is executable, finite, physically sane, signature-unique physics data; Track-01 object is a problem, formula IDs, Python solution, and numeric answer record; collected as an existing promoted Card.

物理推理数据稀缺，因为普通文本生成容易产出语言流畅但无法求解、数值矛盾或公式错误的问题。静态 benchmark 也很少提供适合训练和自动验证的可执行解题轨迹。

Infinite Problem Generator 把物理公式表示为 Python 函数，用专家教材题扩展新场景，并在接受前执行每个生成解法。直接产物是 ClassicalMechanicsV1，其中每条问题、代码与答案记录都能机械检查可解性和结构复杂度。

L4 事实：官方来源为 arXiv:2603.14486v1，日期为 2026-03-15；目前仅确认 arXiv 预印本，未确认正式会议；判定边界是可执行、结果有限、物理合理且签名唯一的物理数据；Track 01 对象是题目、公式编号、Python 解法与数值答案组成的记录；该条目是已有并已提升的 Card。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
IPG makes the solution program, rather than an LLM's confidence, the verification surface. A generator may vary the narrative, variables, and formula chain, but the accepted record must execute against a fixed Formula-as-Code library, produce a finite value in a physically valid range, and have a non-duplicate formula/target signature.

Google Scholar citations: 0（checked 2026-07-27；https://scholar.google.com/scholar_lookup?title=Infinite+Problem+Generator%3A+Verifiably+Scaling+Physics+Reasoning+Data+with+Agentic+Workflows&author=Aditya+Sharan&hl=en）

Open dataset: yes. Dataset name: ClassicalMechanicsV1. Official URL: https://huggingface.co/datasets/erads/ClassicalMechanicsV1. Scale: 1,335 undergraduate classical-mechanics records expanded from 165 expert seeds, covering 102 formulas with mean complexity 3.05 formulas. Record form: question, formula IDs, variable assignments, executable Python solve function, and numeric result; exact storage schema and dataset license were not confirmed. Construction uses Gemini 2.5 Flash plus a predefined formula library; execution/range/signature checks and an independent Gemini 3 audit filter the corpus. Intended use: physics SFT, curriculum construction, and executable evaluation.

IPG 把解题程序而不是 LLM 自信度作为验证对象。生成器可以改变叙事、变量和公式链，但记录只有在固定的 Formula-as-Code 库上成功执行、得到处于物理合理范围的有限数值，并且公式与目标变量签名不重复时才能保留。

Google Scholar 引用数：0（查询于 2026-07-27；https://scholar.google.com/scholar_lookup?title=Infinite+Problem+Generator%3A+Verifiably+Scaling+Physics+Reasoning+Data+with+Agentic+Workflows&author=Aditya+Sharan&hl=en）

开源数据：有。数据集名称：ClassicalMechanicsV1。官方地址：https://huggingface.co/datasets/erads/ClassicalMechanicsV1。规模：由 165 道专家教材题扩展得到 1,335 条本科经典力学记录，覆盖 102 个公式，平均每题使用 3.05 个公式。记录形式：题目、公式编号、变量赋值、可执行 Python 求解函数与数值结果；具体存储结构和数据集许可未确认。构造使用 Gemini 2.5 Flash 与预定义公式库，并通过执行、范围、签名检查及独立 Gemini 3 审计过滤。预期用途：物理 SFT、课程数据构造与可执行评测。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Prepare seeds and axioms. Input: 165 expert question-solution pairs from undergraduate mechanics and a textbook formula compilation. Operation: digitize formulas as tested Python functions with typed variables. Output: seed records plus an executable axiom library. Check: each axiom must execute independently and expose its valid domain.
  2. Plan scenarios and formula chains. Input: one seed and the formula library. Operation: Gemini 2.5 Flash proposes scenario families and chooses three to five connected formulas and a target variable. Output: a structural blueprint. Check: the target must be derivable using only the selected axioms.
  3. Generate round-robin variants. Input: the blueprint and scenario list. Operation: cycle across scenarios, write the natural-language problem, assign constrained values, and emit a Python solve function. Output: candidate problem-code records. Check: a hash of formula IDs plus target variable must be unique; collisions trigger regeneration.
  4. Execute and repair. Input: candidate code. Operation: run it in a sandbox and feed syntax/runtime errors back to the generator. Output: an executable finite numeric result. Check: reject NaN/infinity and values violating basic sign or magnitude rules.
  5. Audit and prune. Input: 1,415 generated candidates. Operation: remove 80 records with fewer than two deductive steps and use Gemini 3 to audit semantic agreement among text, formulas, code, and answer. Output: 1,335 released records. Check: report residual issues by formula-count stratum rather than treating execution as semantic proof.

Reproducibility: paper, MIT-licensed code, dataset, and an evaluation report are linked. Reproduction must pin formula definitions, prompts/models, retry policy, numeric tolerances, seed rights, and dataset license; generation reportedly costs 22-122 LLM calls per accepted record.

1. 准备种子与公理。 输入：165 道本科力学专家题及解答，以及教材公式汇编。操作：把公式数字化为经过测试、带类型变量的 Python 函数。输出：种子记录与可执行公理库。检查：每个公理必须能独立执行并标明有效取值范围。
  2. 规划场景与公式链。 输入：一道种子题和公式库。操作：Gemini 2.5 Flash 提出场景类型，选择 3 至 5 个相连公式及目标变量。输出：结构蓝图。检查：目标必须只靠所选公理即可推出。
  3. 轮换生成变体。 输入：结构蓝图与场景列表。操作：在不同场景间轮换，编写自然语言题目、设置受约束数值并生成 Python 求解函数。输出：候选题目与代码记录。检查：公式编号集合和目标变量组成的哈希必须唯一；冲突时重新生成。
  4. 执行并修复。 输入：候选代码。操作：在 sandbox 中运行，并把语法或运行错误反馈给生成器。输出：可执行的有限数值结果。检查：拒绝 NaN、无穷值以及违反基本符号或数量级规则的结果。
  5. 审计并裁剪。 输入：1,415 条生成候选。操作：删除少于两个推导步骤的 80 条记录，并由 Gemini 3 审计文本、公式、代码与答案的语义一致性。输出：1,335 条发布记录。检查：按公式数量报告残余问题，不能把成功执行当作语义正确的充分证明。

复现信息：论文、采用 MIT 许可的代码、数据集与评估报告均有链接。复现时必须固定公式定义、prompt 与模型、重试策略、数值容差、种子使用权和数据集许可；每条接受记录据报需要 22 至 122 次 LLM 调用。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Generation and pruning claim. The pipeline produces 1,415 candidates from 165 seeds, then removes 80 shallow records to release 1,335 examples spanning 102 formulas with mean formula count 3.05. Only two numerical-instability failures are reported, showing that execution catches arithmetic/runtime failures at scale; this does not establish full physical correctness.

Semantic-audit claim. An independent audit of high-complexity records finds roughly 4-15% text/code, signature, or formula-consistency issues across the four-to-six-formula strata. The important evidence is therefore not perfect correctness, but that residual errors are measurable and rise with structural complexity despite executable verification.

生成与裁剪主张。 流程从 165 道种子题生成 1,415 条候选，删除 80 条浅层记录后发布 1,335 条样本，覆盖 102 个公式，平均公式数为 3.05。论文只报告 2 次数值不稳定失败，说明执行检查能大规模捕获算术和运行错误，但这不能证明物理语义完全正确。

语义审计主张。 独立审计在使用 4 至 6 个公式的高复杂度记录中发现约 4% 至 15% 的文本代码、签名或公式一致性问题。因此关键证据不是数据完全无错，而是即使有可执行验证，残余错误仍可测量并会随结构复杂度上升。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier synthetic physics pipelines rely mainly on textual self-consistency or post-hoc LLM judging. IPG constrains generation with an executable domain axiom library and stores the program needed to reproduce each answer. Its formula/target signature also controls structural duplication and makes formula count a curriculum variable. Program execution is not new; the new element is using Formula-as-Code as the generation substrate, acceptance rule, and complexity measure for physics records.
以往合成物理数据流程主要依赖文本自洽或事后 LLM 判断。IPG 用可执行领域公理库约束生成，并保存复现每个答案所需的程序。公式与目标变量签名还能控制结构重复，并把公式数量变成课程难度变量。程序执行本身并不新，新意在于把 Formula-as-Code 同时用作物理记录的生成基础、接受规则与复杂度指标。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• Execution proves numerical consistency with the encoded axioms, not that the narrative models real physics; the independent audit still finds more errors in complex records.
  • The 165 seeds and fixed formula library bound topical diversity, while benchmark decontamination and textbook-rights analysis are not reported.
  • Generation is expensive at 22-122 LLM calls per accepted problem, and no downstream controlled SFT improvement is reported.

• 成功执行只能证明数值与编码公理一致，不能证明题目叙事符合真实物理；独立审计仍在复杂记录中发现更多错误。
  • 165 道种子与固定公式库限制了主题多样性，论文也未报告 benchmark 去污染和教材权利分析。
  • 每道接受题需要 22 至 122 次 LLM 调用，生成成本较高；论文没有报告受控的下游 SFT 提升实验。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
• Reuse the architecture when a STEM domain can be expressed as tested functions with explicit validity ranges; it is well suited to generating executable SFT or evaluation records.
  • Treat formula count and dependency structure as curriculum controls, then separately audit linguistic realism and physical assumptions.
  • Before redistribution or training, verify the dataset license, textbook provenance, code/text agreement, and overlap with target evaluations.

• 当某个 STEM 领域能表示为带明确有效范围、经过测试的函数时，可复用该架构生成可执行 SFT 或评测记录。
  • 可把公式数量与依赖结构作为课程难度控制，但要另外审计语言真实性和物理假设。
  • 在分发或训练前，应核实数据集许可、教材来源、代码与文本一致性，以及与目标评测的重叠。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Position: replace unverifiable free-form physics generation with executable problem-solution records.
  • Method handle: encode formulas, plan a chain, generate a scenario and solver, execute, deduplicate, then audit.
  • Data/artifact handle: ClassicalMechanicsV1 releases 1,335 records; official code, data, and evaluation report are linked.
  • Evidence anchor: 1,415 candidates become 1,335 records, while complex-stratum audits still expose 4-15% issues.
  • Reuse decision: useful where formulas are codifiable, provided semantic review and source/license audits remain separate gates.

• 一句话定位： 用可执行题目与解答记录替代无法验证的自由生成物理数据。
  • 方法抓手： 编码公式、规划公式链、生成场景与求解器、执行、去重，再进行语义审计。
  • 数据与产物抓手： ClassicalMechanicsV1 发布 1,335 条记录，并提供官方代码、数据和评估报告链接。
  • 证据锚点： 1,415 条候选得到 1,335 条记录，但复杂度分层审计仍发现 4% 至 15% 的问题。
  • 复用决定： 适合公式可编码的领域，但语义复核与来源许可审计必须保持为独立关卡。
